evidence:
REACHABILITY. Runtime: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-for-byte the template Dockerfile (node:22-bookworm-slim, NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules, express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 preinstalled globally), matching instruction.md:13 ('Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages') and integration.md:3-5. Launch contract: instruction.md:13 (node /app/server.js, PORT, GET /api/health without DB, DB_PATH) and hireops_rules.md:198-202 (launch env PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT, DB_PATH; non-/app working dir; writable copy) agree with test.sh:97-111 (env -i with exactly those five variables, uid 65534, APP_COPY fallback, DB_PATH=$APP_DB). Seed: every account named in instruction.md:17 exists in seed users with the stated role (10 users); 3 jobs with interview_limit; 16 applications with stage/position, APP-301 carries rejected_from/reject_reason; 127 messages (APP-101 has 120 = the 'long one', rules:206-208); 3 notes; 6 read markers; candidate_status_labels and thread_page_size=30 present as rules:208-209 promise. Seeded facts graders rely on are derivable: Lena's 1 unread (APP-301 has 3 messages, her read_count=2, 3rd sender USR-REC3), Platform Engineer order Greta/Ade/Marco and Priya/Samuel from positions, Noor's note text. Password is given publicly (instruction.md:17, rules:11); no hash needed in seed. Network: browser CDN allowed (instruction.md:13, integration.md:12-14), server must not depend on an outside service; consistent with the SKILL delivery profile (network public). Achievability is supported by the hash-verified scripted golden run (raw-evidence-index entries for qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/*, all hashes match current files and frozen solution bytes): 25 groups including transitions, interview places, stale refusal naming the actor, roles, bulk all-or-none, undo semantics, paging 30, unread/seen, drafts, live board arrival 804 ms, candidate privacy, all passed:true. This is not a configured judge run and is not claimed as one.

ONE READING (graded paths). I walked every functional protocol step against the public text and found a single reasonable reading for each graded behaviour: one-stage moves and skip refusal (rules:47-48); reject needs a non-blank reason, not from Hired (49); reopen only to rejected-from stage, reason cleared (51); arrival at bottom (57-58); interview cap, reorder inside always allowed, freed place usable (63-65); manager limited to own job and Interview/Offer/Hired incl. reject/reopen from those (70-72), and adding candidates/opening jobs reserved to recruiters (16, 28, 31); 409 stale with 'by whom' (77-80) — 'Every card carries a version' makes the replay-exactly-as-sent test in protocol C unambiguous; optimistic put-back with reason and focus (84-85); bulk board order 'by stage in the order listed above, then by place' (89-92); undo semantics (96-100) — 'restores a rejection reason that the move removed' makes reopen an undoable move (protocol M), 'an earlier move is no longer undoable once the same person has made a later one' fixes the single-level reading tested in B(12)/hro_undo_once, and 'Adding a note does not count' plus 'any of those cards' fixes the B(12) control; I traced J2 positions through B(1)-(15) and J1 through M/L/R and every expected order/outcome follows uniquely from the rules (e.g. B(5) Y,W,X,Z,A2; B(13) A2,V; L undo of E refused then allowed). Activity (110-113), live updates within 15 s preserving typing/focus/open card/scroll (117-123), paging 30 with remaining count and anchored scroll (144-147), unread definition and seed read markers (151-160, 207-208), seen including 'observer never counts' and job manager counting (164-166), drafts per person/conversation/browser (170-175), candidate wording table and data exclusions (177-194), status codes 401/403/404 (21-23) are all explicit. Instruction.md and the rules file do not contradict each other (instruction.md 'as long as nobody has touched those cards' is narrowed, not contradicted, by rules:98-99 on notes).

CONFORMING-ALTERNATIVE PROBE. (a) An app that hides/disables the full-Interview move: instruction.md:3 requires 'tell me why', and hro_refused_put_back explicitly accepts 'A UI that refuses before the card moves, with the reason shown and focus on that card'; a silent hide is not a reasonable reading of 'tell me why'. (b) Undo scoped per job vs per person: rules:96 'their own most recent move' reads per person; no graded step diverges under either reading (I checked every undo in M, L, B). (c) Managers not shown other jobs' boards/conversations: criteria accept 'not offered/not listed, or refused' (hro_notes, hro_thread_access, hro_mgr_other_job) and protocols read versions from a session that can see the card. (d) Activity as one line per multi-card move is explicitly accepted. No conforming alternative I could construct fails a graded criterion due to ambiguity. BROKEN-APP PROBE: an app that implements staleness by from-stage instead of a version would accept the ABA replay in protocol C and correctly fail, because rules:77 mandates a version; that is a public requirement, not a hidden one.

UNGRADED AMBIGUITIES REPORTED (no scoring impact, Note-level only): (1) Whether a within-stage re-order or a rejection is itself an undoable 'move' (rules:57-59 say cards are 'moved up or down', rules:98 lists 're-ordered' separately); no criterion undoes a reorder or a rejection. (2) instruction.md:7 'get signed out' / rules:172-173 'session ends mid-reply' leave open whether an explicit Sign out must keep drafts, and no session-expiry policy is defined; hro_drafts grades only conversation switch, Board and reload. (3) Whether hiring managers may read other jobs' boards or the Activity view is unstated; graded rows accept either. (4) Whether a bulk set may include a card already in the target stage, or bulk-reject, is unstated; untested. (5) Workbook conflict, not a task defect: the Internal Quality Checks annotation for row 6 says 'no network', while the public Quality Checks row and SKILL.md delivery profile say network is allowed/public; per the skill's delivery profile the task's CDN allowance and network_mode='public' are correct. Instruction note: a development-time /app/app.db left by the agent would be used as-is (test.sh:98, 109), but instruction.md:15 'start with no shipped database' states this publicly, so it is reachable and unambiguous.
